notes.claude: Cache-hit (read) rate captured under cachedInputPerMillion. Cache-write rates (1.25x base for 5m, 2x for 1h) are not represented; cost framework treats CachedInputTokens as read-side discount.
notes.codex: gpt-5.5 short-context rate ($5/$30). Long-context tier (above ~270k input tokens) is not represented; current pipeline workloads sit well below that threshold.
notes.gemini: gemini-3-pro-preview is the current default Pro model (gemini-3.0-pro is not on the live pricing page). Short-context rate (<= 200k tokens); long-context tier (>200k) is not represented.
notes.opencode: opencode-go uses a flat subscription ($10/month) and does not publish per-token rates for its bundled models; intentionally omitted from defaults. Operators who want USD-equivalent cost attribution under opencode can override per (model, agent) in their own config — see docs/agent-pricing.md.
notes.cursor: Cursor uses a flat subscription and does not publish per-token rates; intentionally omitted from defaults.
notes.copilot: Copilot uses a flat subscription and does not publish per-token rates; intentionally omitted from defaults.
